Before you click “ buy a freshwater stingray ,” consider the following: Stingrays require very large tanks , typically starting from 180 gallons or more . As adults, some species can grow over 24 inches in diameter. Soft sand is preferred to protect their delicate undersides. Avoid sharp or rough gravel that can cause injuries. Stingrays can coexist with other peaceful fish, but tank mates should be large enough not to be mistaken as food and calm enough not to stress the stingray. They enjoy a carnivorous diet—shrimp, earthworms, bloodworms, and high-protein pellets are essential for growth and energy. Stingrays are very sensitive to ammonia and nitrites . A powerful filtration system and regular water changes are mandatory.
